case_caption: Elon Musk et al. v. Samuel Altman et al.
scope_note: Website analysis and trial-wiki commentary run through May 5, 2026. Primary docket archive runs through May 3, 2026 (entry #522). Trial began April 27, 2026 and is bifurcated under PTO #4 (#477) into liability (Apr 28 - ~May 15) and remedies (~May 18+) phases. Per PTO #3 (#456), disgorgement is an equitable remedy decided by the Court, not the jury. Day-by-day trial coverage is in case-files/ trial-wiki commentary, treated as secondary observation. Live claims after the Apr 24, 2026 order (#497): charitable trust and unjust enrichment/restitution against the OpenAI defendants, plus aiding and abetting fiduciary breach against Microsoft = 3 total. Fraud and constructive fraud were dismissed with prejudice before openings.
